# Owned object pair scalar result fixture

A public static method has one Object-bounded method formal in two direct
arguments, a boolean configuration input and an opaque integer result. Its
caller retains Object inputs without inspecting, copying or exchanging them.
Source and SDK-provider profiles compile every recovered unit and compare all
original compiler entries, metadata and Exceptions. Frozen independent callers
use direct, separately compiled, reflection and method-handle routes. They cover
nulls, aliases, both flags, arbitrary integer results, partial writes, callback
mutations and exact RuntimeException/Error identities in 96 fresh JVM cases,
each repeated twice. Six wrong programs must fail the independent observer;
six Signature-only controls preserve every original Code byte and descriptor.
Only owned fixture programs execute. The fixture requires JDK 21 and D8.
